subject: Brighton beat ten-man Brentford to climb above Man City into second
title: Brighton climb as Brentford lose Thiago

lines.vo: Brighton are above Manchester City. Brentford helped a little.
Brighton won two-nil, and now sit second, five points behind Arsenal.
Diego Gomez opened the scoring from long range in the fifteenth minute.
Eight minutes later, Igor Thiago was sent off after a VAR review. In eight minutes, Brentford went from one down to ten men.
Pascal Gross added a penalty before half-time. Eleven against ten, and calm as ever.
Keith Andrews criticised the officials. It was Brentford's second league game this season to end with ten men.
Brighton climb. City slip. Brentford are still counting to eleven.
